verdict.rationale: Artificial Analysis, an independent third-party leaderboard, lists Gemini models throughout. It ranks Gemini 4 Carbon among the highest-intelligence models, so a founder can check performance against non-vendor numbers. missing for 10: corroboration from more than one independent leaderboard or eval suite, and evidence of per-benchmark third-party results beyond a single summary ranking.

support.subject: As a founder, the model shows up in independent third-party evaluations and leaderboards, so I am not relying only on vendor-run numbers

citations.quote: Gemini 4 Carbon (high) and Claude Opus 5.5 (max with fallback) are the highest intelligence models, followed by Gemini 4 Carbon (medium) and Claude Opus 5.5 (xhigh with fallback).
